subject.title: WebChat: a config-change gateway restart drops the in-flight turn (empty/failed session, recovery can't resume, no user notice)

question: Is a persistent WebChat transcript recovery notice sufficient for this issue, or should the fix also prevent/resume the interrupted turn?
rationale: The source-level no-notice bug is clear, but the issue's expected behavior allows three materially different product contracts with different session-state and side-effect tradeoffs.

options.title: Accept Notice-First Fix
options.body: Land the linked transcript-notice PR as the first fix and keep restart deferral or immediate user-message persistence as separate follow-up work.

options.title: Require Turn Preservation
options.body: Hold the linked PR until the same change also proves restart deferral or durable inbound user-message persistence for interrupted WebChat turns.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Recovery Design
options.body: Route this under a broader non-resumable restart recovery design with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/95609 and avoid a scoped notice-only merge.

recommendation.title: Accept Notice-First Fix
recommendation.body: Land the linked transcript-notice PR as the first fix and keep restart deferral or immediate user-message persistence as separate follow-up work.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best history-backed decision owner for the transcript/delivery-mirror contract and adjacent restart recovery surface.
